value.rationale: This classifies a natural, physically motivated bias-control problem by a directly measurable normalized cycle mismatch, not an arbitrary unmotivated example. It gives a sharp qualitative shift from an achieved unique finite-bias optimum to a weak-bias supremum and resolves the singular zero-mismatch regime. The explicit b=1/5 example has a nontrivial 1.879 efficiency gain, and the universal result needs only second moments. No broader downstream claim is required.
